name: books-as-data
description: An AI-assisted natural language interface for exploring "Books as Data", the digitised-books platform of four Swiss libraries.
long_description: An open-source Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for the "Books as Data" platform. It provides natural language access for exploring, searching, and retrieving 750k+ titles from Swiss libraries, 1700–1900 — over a million records, under half with OCR full text. Ten tools cover metadata and keyword search, full record details, breakdowns by facet, exact two-dimension facet cross-tabs, paged OCR full-text retrieval, query autocompletion, AI-based IIIF-image analysis, per-page OCR text with layout coordinates, locating a phrase across a scanned volume's pages, plus the research guidance itself, one topic per call.

tools.name: sgbr_search
tools.description: Search full text, catalogue metadata and AI plate descriptions, narrowed or excluded by facet; returns compact ranked hits with OCR snippets.

tools.name: sgbr_get_record
tools.description: Fetch a full record by id: CSL-JSON citation, IIIF manifest, full-text links, GND/GeoNames authorities.

tools.name: sgbr_facet_values
tools.description: Break a query down by facet: library, language, year, author, genre, topic and more.

tools.name: sgbr_facet_breakdown
tools.description: Cross-tabulate two facets into an exact grid of record counts, e.g. language x genre.

tools.name: sgbr_get_fulltext
tools.description: Read a scanned item's OCR full text, paged (expect OCR noise on 1700–1900 Fraktur).

tools.name: sgbr_autocomplete
tools.description: Turn a partial term into title / author / subject search phrases.

tools.name: sgbr_inspect_image
tools.description: Fetch a IIIF page image (map, plate, illustration, cover) for direct visual inspection — whole page or a percent-region crop.

tools.name: sgbr_get_page_ocr
tools.description: Fetch one page's OCR text and layout regions (line/word/block boxes with pixel + percent coordinates) from IIIF hOCR — locate text on a page and derive region_pct crops for sgbr_inspect_image.

tools.name: sgbr_locate_text
tools.description: Find which scanned page(s) contain a phrase — returns the page, a context snippet, and line/word regions (bbox_px + region_pct for sgbr_inspect_image); searches one volume and lists sibling volumes for multivolume works.

tools.name: sgbr_guide
tools.description: How to search Books as Data well, one topic at a time: query syntax traps, historic spelling, OCR, facets, citing pages, fold-out plates. Read it before the first search.

access_token.title: Access token (optional)
access_token.description: Bearer token for ACL-restricted records. Leave blank for anonymous access to all public content.

graphql_endpoint.title: GraphQL endpoint override (optional)
graphql_endpoint.description: Alternative RDV GraphQL endpoint URL. Leave blank to use the built-in default; set when the API moves hosts.

fulltext_endpoint.title: Full-text endpoint override (optional)
fulltext_endpoint.description: Alternative OCR full-text REST base URL. Leave blank to use the built-in default; set when the API moves hosts.

image_endpoint.title: IIIF image endpoint override (optional)
image_endpoint.description: Alternative IIIF Image API base URL for page images. Leave blank to use the built-in default; set when the API moves hosts.

ocr_endpoint.title: OCR endpoint override (optional)
ocr_endpoint.description: Alternative mediaserver base URL for per-page hOCR/plain-text OCR assets. Leave blank to use the built-in default; set when the mediaserver moves hosts.
